name: com.instavar/mcp-server
description: Free Remotion video templates and creative guides; optional hosted Studio rendering and publishing.

environmentVariables.name: INSTAVAR_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional key from https://instavar.com/studio/settings that unlocks hosted workflows.

environmentVariables.name: INSTAVAR_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the Instavar API host. Defaults to https://instavar.com.

discovery.startHere: Call get_capabilities, then list_templates and get_template before scaffolding a VideoSpec. Get local rendering instructions to produce a video on the user's machine.
discovery.authentication: No account or API key for template tools and creative guides. INSTAVAR_API_KEY unlocks separate hosted Studio workflows.
discovery.boundaries: Planning and scaffolding do not render, upload or publish media. Hosted production can incur costs. Publishing requires explicit user approval. Independent of Remotion AG.
discovery.remotePlanningNote: Related HTTP product surface, not identical to the npm tool inventory: anonymous video/carousel planning and optional OAuth private project review.
discovery.protectedStudioNote: Separate hosted Studio surface; OAuth authentication required.

title: Instavar Video Templates and Studio
